clue.text: Learning about a hot city in Pakistan

indicators.note: about means the word for learning goes round the other pieces

parts.note: lore is accumulated learning or knowledge
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone's education takes place in a sweltering Pakistani city.
explanation.definitionFit: Lahore is the capital of Punjab province, a major city in Pakistan.

clue.text: Bigger drink about right

indicators.note: about means the drink goes round the abbreviation for right

parts.note: lager is a drink, a pale beer

explanation.surface: A bigger beer is about right.
explanation.definitionFit: Larger and bigger are both comparatives of size, direct synonyms.

clue.text: Welcome novels, books about the past

parts.note: hi is a word of welcome
novels are stories

explanation.surface: Greeting novels alongside history books.
explanation.definitionFit: Accounts of past events are histories, works recording former times.

clue.text: Fairy tale spirit spins little shreds, impressing king

parts.note: rum is a spirit

indicators.note: impressing means pressing the king into the jumbled letters
shreds means the letters of spins and little are torn up into a new order

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: In a fairy tale, a spinner tears up little scraps with a king inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shreds' looks like a noun but is the anagram signal; 'spirit' is not the imp but a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Rumpelstiltskin is the Grimm fairy tale named after the imp who spins straw into gold.

clue.text: OK to enter figure, seeing ability

indicators.note: to enter means the word for OK goes inside the figure

parts.note: eight is a figure, a number
yes is an agreeing OK

explanation.surface: An agreement to let a number in, and somehow it becomes about vision.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight or vision is the faculty of seeing, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Narrative that may be woven?

definitions.meaning: a tall story or tale told at length
spun thread used in weaving or knitting

explanation.surface: A story that someone spins.
explanation.definitionFit: Yarn means both a long tale and spun thread, and tales are said to be woven.

clue.text: Rapper's ranting upset gangster ultimately, fellow combatant

indicators.note: upset means the letters are knocked over into a new order
ultimately picks the closing letter of the word gangster

explanation.surface: A rapper's tirade upsets a gangster, who becomes a rival fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer's practice opponent is a training partner who fights alongside them.

clue.text: £1,000 — magnificent!

explanation.surface: An exclamation of delight at a thousand pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Grand is slang for a thousand, and also means splendid or imposing.

clue.text: Source of pleasure is English essay

parts.note: a treat is something enjoyable

explanation.surface: Reading an English essay can be a delight.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal written discourse on a subject is a lengthy essay.

clue.text: With respect to problem marriage, finally continue

parts.note: re means concerning or with respect to
a sum is an arithmetic problem

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word marriage

explanation.surface: A note on a troubled marriage, ending with the decision to carry on.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up again after a pause is to carry on, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Primate takes bite into fruit

indicators.note: into means the word for bite is put inside the fruit

parts.note: a grape is a fruit
to bite is to eat

explanation.surface: A monkey or ape snacks on a piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' is only a link joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorillas, chimpanzees and orangutans are the great apes, members of the primate order.

clue.text: Buccaneers traipse all over the place

indicators.note: all over the place means the letters of traipse are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Buccaneers wander about everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Buccaneers were sea raiders of the Caribbean, synonymous with sea robbers.

clue.text: So in sci-fi film, boy is mysterious

indicators.note: in means the word so is placed inside the film title

parts.note: ET is Spielberg's 1982 science-fiction film
Eric is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A boy in a science-fiction film turns out to be enigmatic.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric knowledge is obscure, understood only by a few, so it is mysterious to outsiders.

clue.text: Believe short quote about communist

indicators.note: about means the trimmed quote goes round the communist
short means the word for quote loses its final letter

parts.note: to cite is to quote
red is a common term for a communist

explanation.surface: Trust a brief quotation about a communist.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit a story is to accept it as true, a synonym of trusting it.

clue.text: Initially lost, beautiful work of art

indicators.note: initially lost means the first letter of the word for beautiful is dropped

parts.note: fetching means attractive or beautiful

explanation.surface: A beautiful artwork that has gone missing.
explanation.definitionFit: A print made from an acid-bitten metal plate is a kind of artwork.

clue.text: Immediate sensation, aunt dancing

indicators.note: dancing means the letters of the two words move about into a new order

explanation.surface: An aunt's dancing causes an instant stir.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening at once, with no delay, is instantaneous: a direct synonym.

clue.text: Ship's lieutenant and equipment thrown overboard, we hear, after ten uprising

indicators.note: after means the lieutenant follows the raised ten
uprising means the number is read upwards in this down clue

parts.note: ten is written in figures as 1 and 0, read as IO

indicators.note: we hear means the word sounds like letters spelt differently

parts.note: an anchor is ship's equipment dropped over the side

explanation.surface: A lieutenant on a ship hears gear tossed into the sea during a mutiny.
explanation.walkthrough: Ten as digits 10 looks like IO; 'uprising' reads it upwards as OI. 'we hear' turns ANCHOR into ANKER.
explanation.definitionFit: A tanker carrying petroleum is a type of ship.

clue.text: Complicated detail, so withdrawn

indicators.note: complicated means the letters of detail and so are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: An intricate detail makes someone retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone withdrawn keeps apart from others, solitary and cut off.

clue.text: Around church, scattered epistles in a papal place of worship

indicators.note: around means the scrambled letters surround the abbreviation for church
scattered means the letters of epistles, in and a are strewn into a new order

explanation.surface: Letters of the apostles strewn around a church in a papal setting.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sistine Chapel is the Pope's chapel in the Vatican, where conclaves are held.

clue.text: Accommodation to rent — county has it

parts.note: Beds is the abbreviation for Bedfordshire, an English county

explanation.surface: A county has a room to let.
explanation.walkthrough: BEDS is short for Bedfordshire, a county north of London. A bedsit is a British rented single room used for both living and sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-room flat combining bedroom and sitting room is rented lodging.

clue.text: Find old moggy in middle of glen

indicators.note: in means the old cat goes inside the central letters
middle of takes the two central letters of the word glen

parts.note: moggy is British slang for an ordinary cat

explanation.surface: Track down an elderly cat lost in a Scottish valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' gives LE from GLEN; 'in' puts OCAT between L and E. A moggy is British slang for a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: To find where something is placed is to pinpoint it, a synonym.

clue.text: Tea to keep in teacups etc?

indicators.note: to keep means the word for tea holds the word in

parts.note: cha is slang for tea

explanation.surface: Tea is kept in teacups.
explanation.walkthrough: Cha is British slang for tea, from the Chinese word.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain crockery such as cups and saucers is called by this material name.

clue.text: Develop popular line

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a crease is a line or fold

explanation.surface: Building up a well-liked range of products.
explanation.definitionFit: To grow or expand is to develop, synonyms as verbs.

clue.text: Old South American appears during curtain call

indicators.note: during means the letters sit within the phrase curtain call

explanation.surface: An ancient Peruvian takes a bow at the end of a show.
explanation.definitionFit: The Incas ruled an empire in the Andes before the Spanish conquest.

clue.text: Not thick, monarch using his brain?

parts.note: thin is the opposite of thick
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: A clever ruler, far from dim, at work with his mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not thick' in the surface means not stupid, but here it means slim.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone using their brain is engaged in mental reasoning, so the participle fits.

clue.text: Reptiles coming from opposite directions — fishes losing head

parts.note: south and north are opposite compass directions, S and N

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter of the fish word is dropped

parts.note: hakes are fishes of the cod family

explanation.surface: Reptiles approach from both sides while fish lose their heads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing head' takes the H off HAKES to leave AKES.
explanation.definitionFit: Serpents such as adders and pythons are legless reptiles.

clue.text: Approach organ that's been sketched?

parts.note: drawn means sketched, done in pencil
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: Moving closer to a drawing of an ear.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsical second reading of the phrase as a sketched body part.
explanation.definitionFit: To come closer is to approach, a phrasal synonym.

clue.text: Boring drivel a problem in the house?

parts.note: dry means dull or boring
rot is nonsense or drivel

explanation.surface: Tedious nonsense causing trouble at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Fungal decay of timber is a common structural problem in houses.
